name: Guilty: Mighty Bunny

weapon.name: Sniper Rifle
weapon.description:
■ Affects target(s).
<color=#00AEFF>Deals 69.04% of ATK as damage.
Charge Time: 1 sec.
Full Charge Damage: 250% of damage.
Deals 200% damage when attacking core.</color>

typeInfo.description: High accuracy shooting from long range makes it perfect for targeting specific enemy parts.

description: Guilty in a high-tech exoskeleton bunny girl suit. She has become even stronger thanks to the suit's boost to her already overwhelming physical strength. However, she still gets entirely docile in front of the one person who helped her get rehabilitated.

lines.text: I even get to be a bunny girl now that I'm rehabilitated... How fascinating...
Will I be able to properly handle this outfit...?
Once this is over... will you remove my restraints?
I guess you like this kind of position, Counselor...
Think you'll be able to handle me even in this outfit...?
Aren't you being a little too handsy just because I'm tied up...?
I'm bored... You know, I could easily break free from these...
If I stay put, you'll hold my hand, right...? Then I'll be good and wait...
I think I'm starting to get used to this place...
There are others wearing outfits like mine... How curious...
I wonder what everyone else does for fun around here...
What do you think, Counselor? It's my first time dressing up as a bunny girl, so I'm feeling a little awkward...
Who knows what I might be capable of...? You'd better stay right by my side, Counselor...
I don't think I should try to get any stronger than this... Are you sure this is okay?
What if I become too strong... and make people afraid of bunny girls...?
Whoa... Thanks, Counselor. What would you like me to do now?
You must really like my outfit... That's why you're giving me this gift, right?
I feel like luck has been on my side ever since I became a bunny girl...
I'll do anything for you... Just call for me, Counselor...
I can't help wanting more of you, Counselor... You'll keep holding my hand, right?
I heard bunny girls bring good luck... I'll share mine with you, Counselor.
What do you need me to do this time...?
You called...?
I don't have to hop around like a bunny, right...?
I brought you good luck... Now untie me, Counselor...
This shouldn't take long...
If we win, you'll hold my hand again, right...?
Will I be able to make proper use of this outfit...?
This outfit is uncomfortable...
Aren't you afraid of me...?
I think I could manage even without a gun...
I'm ready, Counselor. Just say the word...
I'm gonna have as much fun as I want...
Isn't it fun playing with a bunny girl...?
Too easy...
That was fun...
It broke...
Ugh!
Argh...
I don't wanna do this anymore. This is no fun...
I did well, right, Counselor...?
